J9-GAP-P5-routes-bypass-governor.note: governedCall has no production caller (spec P5 detail: git grep -l governedCall -- app lib lists only lib/ai/governor/index.ts). Every frozen spending route reaches its provider without the Governor. P5 wires it, shadow mode first.

J9-GAP-P5-governor-shadow-mode-absent.note: GovernedCallInput has no shadow mode: governedCall always enforces, so a would-be refusal blocks instead of logging and proceeding. P5 adds shadow mode; the flip to enforcing is a human act in P9.

J9-GAP-legacy-text-budget-fail-open.note: lib/ai/budget-enforcer.ts documents a fail-open doctrine: a policy or ledger read error makes reserveBudget return null and previewBudget return, so the text spend proceeds unbudgeted. Spec M10 requires fail-closed on a budget read error; P5 moves text spend onto the fail-closed Governor.

J9-GAP-video-spend-outside-cost-ledger.note: Video settlement (app/api/video/webhook/fal/route.ts via settleQuota) writes only media_spend_events; no pipeline_cost_ledger row is written, while image settlement does (meter.ts trackPipelineCost). Video spend is therefore invisible to ledger-based budgets and cost reports.

J9-GAP-track-cost-non-anthropic-rate-fal.note: lib/pipelines/track-cost.ts calculatePipelineCost prices any model missing from its Anthropic-only MODEL_RATES at claude-sonnet-4-6 rates, so a non-Anthropic call is recorded at a cost different from its registry price (gpt-4-o-mini at 1M/1M tokens: 18 USD recorded vs 0.75 USD).
